1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE Hypothyroidism Levothyroxine sodium tablets are indicated in adult and pediatric patients, including neonates, as a replacement therapy in primary (thyroidal), secondary (pituitary), and tertiary (hypothalamic) congenital or acquired hypothyroidism. (2.1) Advise patients to stop biotin and biotin-containing supplements at least 2 days before assessing TSH and/or T4 levels.
